map.：成人点刺放血单次总量宜控制在 5–10mL 以内（约数滴至 1–2mL/穴）；: : for adults, keep a single prick-bleeding session within 5-10 mL in total (a few drops to 1-2 mL per point); for the frail, elderly or anemic, lower it to 1-3 mL and use fewer points to prevent qi-deficiency dizziness.
